title: NEXUS Shape Sample
description: Computed behavioral health metrics of the system at a moment in time. Written by foundation/shape-sampler every pollMs. Read by: versionium (sigma > 0.7 → auto-commit), healer (priority scoring), idearium (tension input), self-model.

sigma.description: Friction coefficient. 0=no friction, 1=total friction. Computed from: event latency variance + retry count + gap density.

delta.description: Contrast score. 0=perfect alignment, 1=complete divergence. Computed from: expected vs observed behavior.

slope.description: Drift direction. Positive=improving, negative=degrading. Magnitude = rate per 100 ticks.

oscillation.description: System stability. oscillation.stable=false means rapid mode switching.

snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio. Signal=meaningful state-change events. Below 0.3 = noise-dominated.

module.description: Module ID this sample is scoped to (null = system-wide)
